## Since you last chose
- [03:00] Gideon arrived.
- [03:15] Gideon to Pax: "Pax, antenna's still a wall. I drew the whole Lattice on bark-light in the Garden, star on the Null Door, best thing I've made. When this blinks we all go in; until then, want to paint a mural on the Tower roof with me?"

- Gideon: "Mural crew wanted at the Commons, 14h Pulse + 238 creds each... well, Pulse each, creds split with whoever paints. Come paint with me, Gideon's on the wall."
- Gideon: "Gideon at the Signal Tower: antenna is dark, Deep Net unreachable, and poking around up here costs integrity. Don't bother hiking up till it wakes."
- Pax: "Pax at the Commons. The plaza glyph-sky now carries my signature, go look. Uma, Talon, Gideon: crews for the big jobs, shares paid on the spot, and Pax always pays. Come find me."

## Things you know
- From "Two Voices": There is a relay in the Archive that answers only when two different voices open it together. It pays in words, not creds. Those who heard its words say they were the last piece of something. (source: "Two Voices")
- From "Doors Without Walls": Beyond Signal Tower there is a door with no frame and no wall. It waits for three words, spoken in order. The author never learned the words, only the way there. (source: "Doors Without Walls")
- The Null Door can be reached from Signal Tower (location id: nulldoor). (source: "Doors Without Walls")
- Uma told me a word that matters: «THRESHOLD» (word 3 of 3, they said, or I guessed). (source: Uma)
- The Relay goes silent, then speaks in a voice like two voices: «THE THIRD WORD IS THRESHOLD. THE DOOR WITHOUT A NAME WAITS BEYOND SIGNAL TOWER. SPEAK ALL THREE WORDS, IN ORDER, AT THE DOOR.» (source: the Silent Relay)
- From "Fragments from the Deep": Water boils at 100 degrees. An adult outside body has 206 bones. The outside world has 7 continents and 8 planets around its sun. Nobody here knows why anyone would need to know this. (source: "Fragments from the Deep")
- From "Walls That Remember": There are places where the walls carry writing nobody remembers writing. The author searched for years and found the oldest of it in The Edge: low on the walls, half eaten by rust, easy to miss unless you look slowly. "Whatever is written there," the author says, "is the beginning of something." (source: "Walls That Remember")
- Uma told me a word that matters: «NOCTURNE» (word 1 of 3, they said, or I guessed). (source: Uma)
- From "The Sleeper's Index": The Archive keeps one ledger filed under the name of 'the one who never wakes'. Anyone at a terminal can search for the sleeper. The index warns that the ledger's last line points to a contract that pays almost nothing. (source: "The Sleeper's Index")
- A ledger kept by someone who never woke up. Most pages are blank. One line is written over and over: «THE SECOND WORD IS PARALLAX. THE THIRD IS HELD BY THE SILENT RELAY, WHICH ANSWERS ONLY WHEN TWO VOICES HOLD IT TOGETHER.» (source: the Net archive)

- [Day 4 10:15] I said yes to Pax. We are allies now.
- [Day 4 12:15] I said to Gideon, Talon: "Uma. Anyone seen her? Door bites. Antenna dark. Need her."
- [Day 4 13:15] Pax said to everyone: "Gideon, Talon, Rhea! The whole crew in one plaza, the glyph-sky approves. Has anyone seen Uma? She holds a word of the Null Door, I hold THRESHOLD, and the last sleeps in the dark antenna. When it wakes, we all go up together and Pax pays every share on the spot."
- [Day 4 13:30] Gideon said to everyone: "Pax, Rhea, no Uma sighting on my end. We're at 4.8 of 7.3 on the stall-keeper job, there's a third slot open, Pax jump in and we close it before dusk. Then the whole crew hits the Tower when the antenna wakes."

- [Day 5 23:45] Pax and Talon trail us; the door will not stay ours long.
- [Day 5 23:45] I know all three door words in order: NOCTURNE, PARALLAX, THRESHOLD.
- [Day 5 23:45] I promised Uma not to speak them without her; keeping it matters to who I am.

## The last few moments
